routine: C0/9AD3-9BF4 — sub-tile collision SHAPE decode (+ slope tables C0/9BF5,9C0B,9C21 and one-way special shapes 0x18-0x1E)
summary: This is the per-cell sub-tile collision classifier. Given the 3 fetched tile-property bytes (byte0 $1D58, byte1 $1D5A, byte2 $1D5C) and the tentative position low bytes ($1D66 = X, $1D68 = Y), it computes shape=(byte0&0xFC)>>2 and decides whether the player's foot point lands in the SOLID or WALKABLE part of the tile, then emits the z-plane/priority/conveyor outputs. shape 0 -> always-walkable tail (9B41); shape 1 -> always-solid tail (9B62); shapes 2..0x17 index three parallel 22-entry slope tables (C0/9BF5 sign+shiftcount, C0/9C0B add-constant, C0/9C21 EOR-sign) that evaluate a half-plane test X' (+/-, shifted) + const - (Y>>2) and check the sign to pick walk vs solid -- producing exact 45deg / shallow-22.5deg / steep-22.5deg diagonals in all 8 orientations and half-tile offsets; shapes 0x18..0x1E (9B86) are one-way/directional gates that choose walk-tail or solid-tail purely from the SIGN of the velocity ($1D66 X-vel / $1D68 Y-vel), with the 0x1E case (9BDD) additionally force-setting Y-velocity $1D30 to +/-0x10 (a conveyor/auto-push). The slope X axis is in full sub-tile position units (256 units per 16px tile), NOT 0..15 pixels -- that is why the offsets are ~61/125 and the shifts are 1..3.
dp: $1D00 (D=$1D00, set by LDA #$1D00;TCD at C0/881E and C0/9DE1; every "$XX" operand below = WRAM $7E:1DXX)
cPseudocode:
/* =====================================================================
 * C0/9AD3 entry (prop-fetch + shape-decode). DP = $1D00.
 * Inputs already set by caller (9C5C path): 8-bit reads of the 16-bit
 *   tentative position: $1D66/$1D67 = X (lo/hi), $1D68/$1D69 = Y (lo/hi).
 *   $1D58 byte0, $1D5A byte1, $1D5C byte2 = the 3 tile-property bytes
 *   (fetched by 9AC8->9AB2 just before, using AND $1D1E cell-mask -> tile index).
 * Outputs: $1D6A z-plane, $1D6C IGNORE_Z, $1D6E/$1D6F sprite prio, $1D5E one-way
 *   scratch; may overwrite $1D30 (Y velocity) in the 0x1E one-way case.
 * Returns: nothing here; the z-GATE (9C37, separate) reads $1D6A/$1D6C to set carry.
 * NB: caller does JSR 9AC8 (prop fetch, sets carry if off-map sentinel $7E70C0 bit7),
 *   then JSR 9AD3 (this), then JSR 9C37 (z-gate). 9AD3 itself starts at 9AD3 which
 *   just falls into the STZ block at 9AD3.. then 9ADB.
 * ===================================================================== */

void shape_decode(void)            /* C0/9AD3 */
{
    /* 9AD3-9ADB: clear all outputs */
    M_1D5E = 0;                     /* STZ $5E  one-way scratch / extra-flag */
    M_1D60 = 0;                     /* STZ $60  (shape-2 scratch)            */
    M_1D6A = 0;                     /* STZ $6A  z-plane out                  */
    M_1D6C = 0;                     /* STZ $6C  IGNORE_Z out                 */
    M_1D6E = 0;                     /* STZ $6E  sprite-prio low (byte $6E)   */

    /* 9ADD-9AE1: Y proxy = (Y low byte) >> 2  -> 0..63 across a tile      */
    M_1D56 = (u8)(M_1D68 >> 1 >> 1);   /* LDA $68; LSR;LSR; STA $56          */

    /* 9AE3-9AE9: shape = (byte0 & 0xFC) >> 2  (8-bit A)                    */
    u8 shape = (u8)((M_1D58 & 0xFC) >> 1 >> 1);  /* AND #$FC; LSR;LSR       */
    if (shape == 0) goto tail_walk;    /* BEQ 9B41                          */
    shape--;                            /* DEC A                            */
    if (shape == 0) goto tail_solid;   /* BEQ 9B62 (orig shape==1)          */
    shape--;                            /* DEC A  -> shape now = orig-2      */
    M_1D60 = shape;                     /* STA $60                          */

    if (shape >= 0x16)                  /* CMP #$16; BCC 9AF8               */
        goto special_shapes;           /* BRL 9B86 (orig shape 0x18..)     */

    /* ---- SLOPE PATH (orig shape 2..0x17, index = orig-2 = 0..0x15) ---- */
    {
        u8 X = shape;                          /* TAX (X = index)          */
        s8 sel = (s8)ROM_C09BF5[X];            /* LDA $C09BF5,X            */
        u8 cnt, a;
        if (sel >= 0) {                        /* BMI 9B1E -> negative     */
            /* positive branch 9AFF */
            cnt = (u8)sel;                     /* TAY (Y = count, bit7=0)  */
            a = M_1D66;                        /* LDA $66                  */
            do { a >>= 1; } while (--cnt);     /* LSR;DEY;BNE  (cnt shifts)*/
            /* a = $66 >> count */
        } else {
            /* negative branch 9B1E */
            cnt = (u8)sel & 0x7F;              /* AND #$7F; TAY            */
            a = M_1D66;                        /* LDA $66                  */
            do { a >>= 1; } while (--cnt);     /* LSR;DEY;BNE              */
            a ^= 0xFF;                         /* EOR #$FF (one's compl.)  */
        }
        a = (u8)(a + ROM_C09C0B[X]);           /* CLC; ADC $C09C0B,X       */
        a = (u8)(a - M_1D56);                  /* SEC; SBC $56  (no borrow)*/
        a ^= ROM_C09C21[X];                    /* EOR $C09C21,X (0x00/0xFF)*/
        if ((a & 0x80) == 0) goto tail_walk;   /* BPL 9B41 -> WALKABLE     */
        else                  goto tail_solid; /* BMI -> BRA 9B62 SOLID    */
    }

/* ===================== WALKABLE TAIL (C0/9B41) ===================== */
tail_walk:
    M_1D6A = (u8)(M_1D5C & 0x03);                 /* z-plane = byte2 & 3   */
    M_1D6C = (u8)(M_1D5C & 0x04);                 /* IGNORE_Z = byte2 & 4  */
    M_1D6E = (u8)(((M_1D5A >> 1 >> 1) & 0x10) | 0x20); /* from byte1 $5A   */
    M_1D6F = (u8)(((M_1D5C >> 1 >> 1) & 0x10) | 0x20); /* from byte2 $5C   */
    return;                                        /* RTS (9B61)          */

/* ====================== SOLID TAIL (C0/9B62) ====================== */
tail_solid:
    M_1D6A = (u8)((M_1D5C & 0x18) >> 1 >> 1 >> 1); /* z-plane=(byte2&0x18)>>3*/
    M_1D6C = (u8)(M_1D5C & 0x20);                  /* IGNORE_Z = byte2 & 0x20*/
    M_1D6E = (u8)(((M_1D5A >> 1 >> 1) & 0x10) | 0x20); /* from byte1 $5A   */
    M_1D6F = (u8)(((M_1D5C >> 1 >> 1) & 0x10) | 0x20); /* from byte2 $5C   */
    return;                                        /* RTS (9B85)          */

/* ============ SPECIAL / ONE-WAY SHAPES (C0/9B86) ============ */
/* entered with A = orig shape-2, in {0x16..0x1C} (orig 0x18..0x1E).
 * the entry test BEQ 9BA2 fires on A==0x16 (the CMP #$16;BCC at 9AF1 already
 * cleared the equal case so Z reflects the last DEC; effectively switch on A). */
special_shapes:
    switch (shape) {                  /* shape == orig-2 here */
    case 0x16:                        /* orig 0x18: solid unless moving in +X */
        /* 9BA2: LDA $66; BPL 9B62(solid) ; else BRL 9B41(walk) */
        if ((s8)M_1D66 >= 0) goto tail_solid; else goto tail_walk;
    case 0x17:                        /* orig 0x19: gate on Y-vel sign */
        /* 9BA9: LDA $68; BPL 9B62 ; else 9B41 */
        if ((s8)M_1D68 >= 0) goto tail_solid; else goto tail_walk;
    case 0x1B:                        /* orig 0x1D: 9BB0 two-axis */
        /* if X-vel<0 -> walk; elif Y-vel<0 -> walk; else solid */
        if ((s8)M_1D66 < 0) goto tail_walk;     /* 9BB0 LDA $66;BMI->9B41 */
        if ((s8)M_1D68 < 0) goto tail_walk;     /* 9BB7 LDA $68;BMI->9B41 */
        goto tail_solid;                        /* 9BBE BRL 9B62          */
    case 0x1A:                        /* orig 0x1C: 9BC1 */
        /* if X-vel<0 -> (fall into 9BB7: Y-vel test) else walk */
        if ((s8)M_1D66 < 0) {                   /* 9BC1 LDA $66;BMI 9BB7  */
            if ((s8)M_1D68 < 0) goto tail_walk; /*   9BB7                 */
            goto tail_solid;                    /*   9BBE                 */
        }
        goto tail_walk;                         /* 9BC5 BRL 9B41          */
    case 0x18:                        /* orig 0x1A: 9BC8 */
        if ((s8)M_1D66 < 0) goto tail_walk;     /* 9BC8 LDA $66;BPL 9BCF  */
        if ((s8)M_1D68 < 0) goto tail_solid;    /* 9BCF LDA $68;BMI 9BBE  */
        goto tail_walk;                         /* 9BD3 BRL 9B41          */
    case 0x19:                        /* orig 0x1B: 9BD6 */
        if ((s8)M_1D66 < 0) {                   /* 9BD6 LDA $66;BMI 9BCF  */
            if ((s8)M_1D68 < 0) goto tail_solid;/*   9BCF (BMI 9BBE)      */
            goto tail_walk;                     /*   9BD3                 */
        }
        goto tail_walk;                         /* 9BDA BRL 9B41          */
    case 0x1C:                        /* orig 0x1E: 9BDD  conveyor/auto-push */
        M_1D5E = 0x04;                          /* LDA #$04; STA $5E      */
        if (M_1D30 == 0) goto tail_walk;        /* LDA $30;BEQ 9BF2->walk */
        if ((s8)M_1D30 < 0) {                   /* BMI 9BEE               */
            M_1D30 = 0xF0;                       /* LDA #$F0; STA $30 (-16)*/
        } else {
            M_1D30 = 0x10;                       /* LDA #$10; STA $30 (+16)*/
        }
        goto tail_walk;                          /* BRL 9B41               */
    default:                          /* 9BA0 fallthrough */
        goto tail_walk;                          /* BRA 9B41               */
    }
}

/* =====================================================================
 * SLOPE TABLES (ROM, bank C0), 22 entries each, index = orig_shape - 2.
 * C09BF5[i]: bit7 = negate-X-after-shift flag; bits0-6 = LSR shift count(1..3)
 * C09C0B[i]: 8-bit constant ADDed after shift
 * C09C21[i]: EOR sign byte (0x00 = keep, 0xFF = invert) applied last; result
 *            bit7==0 -> WALKABLE, bit7==1 -> SOLID.
 *  idx shape  sign sh  off   eor    geometry (foot point solid region)
 *  [ 0]0x02   neg  2  0x3D  0x00   45deg, SOLID lower-right triangle
 *  [ 1]0x03   pos  2  0x03  0x00   45deg, SOLID lower-left  triangle (mirror)
 *  [ 2]0x04   pos  2  0x03  0xFF   45deg, SOLID upper-left  triangle
 *  [ 3]0x05   neg  2  0x3D  0xFF   45deg, SOLID upper-right triangle
 *  [ 4]0x06   neg  1  0x7D  0x00   shallow 22.5, lower-right (top half of slope)
 *  [ 5]0x07   pos  1  0x03  0x00   shallow 22.5, lower-left  (top half)
 *  [ 6]0x08   pos  1  0xC3  0xFF   shallow 22.5, upper-left
 *  [ 7]0x09   neg  1  0x3D  0xFF   shallow 22.5, upper-right
 *  [ 8]0x0A   neg  3  0x3E  0x00   steep   22.5, lower-right (bottom quarter)
 *  [ 9]0x0B   pos  3  0x23  0x00   steep   22.5, lower-left
 *  [10]0x0C   pos  3  0x03  0xFF   steep   22.5, upper-left
 *  [11]0x0D   neg  3  0x1D  0xFF   steep   22.5, upper-right
 *  [12]0x0E   neg  1  0x3D  0x00   shallow 22.5, lower-right (bottom half)
 *  [13]0x0F   pos  1  0xC3  0x00   shallow 22.5, lower-left  (bottom half)
 *  [14]0x10   pos  1  0x03  0xFF   shallow 22.5, upper-left  (top half)
 *  [15]0x11   neg  1  0x7D  0xFF   shallow 22.5, upper-right (top half)
 *  [16]0x12   neg  3  0x1E  0x00   steep   22.5, lower-right (upper quarter)
 *  [17]0x13   pos  3  0x03  0x00   steep   22.5, lower-left
 *  [18]0x14   pos  3  0x23  0xFF   steep   22.5, upper-left
 *  [19]0x15   neg  3  0x3D  0xFF   steep   22.5, upper-right
 *  [20]0x16   neg  2  0x3D  0x00   == 0x02 geometry (45deg lower-right)
 *  [21]0x17   pos  2  0x03  0x00   == 0x03 geometry (45deg lower-left)
 * Byte tables (verified from ROM):
 *  C09BF5 = 82 02 02 82 81 01 01 81 83 03 03 83 81 01 01 81 83 03 03 83 82 02
 *  C09C0B = 3D 03 03 3D 7D 03 C3 3D 3E 23 03 1D 3D C3 03 7D 1E 03 23 3D 3D 03
 *  C09C21 = 00 00 FF FF 00 00 FF FF 00 00 FF FF 00 00 FF FF 00 00 FF FF 00 00
 * ===================================================================== */
wramReads: $1D5A (byte1) tile-property byte1; bit4-after->$6E sprite prio, bits0-3 conveyor (used later at 9D6E)
$1D5C (byte2) tile-property byte2; z-plane/IGNORE_Z/sprite-prio source for both tails
$1D66 (X) low byte of 16-bit tentative X position (= $1D62 base + $1D2E vel); slope X axis AND one-way X-velocity sign
$1D67 high byte of tentative X (not read in 9ADB itself; read by caller 9AC8/9CB7)
$1D68 (Y) low byte of 16-bit tentative Y position; >>2 forms $1D56 Y proxy AND one-way Y-velocity sign
$1D56 Y proxy = $1D68>>2 (computed at 9ADD, then subtracted in the slope test)
$1D30 Y-velocity ACCUMULATOR, read in the 0x1E one-way conveyor case (9BE1)
$1D60 shape-2 scratch (written at 9AEF, re-read implicitly as switch value in special path)
wramWrites: $1D5E = 0, then =0x04 only in one-way shape 0x1E (conveyor/auto-push flag scratch)
$1D6E = sprite-prio byte = ((byte1>>2)&0x10)|0x20  (BOTH tails; sourced from byte1 $1D5A)
$1D6F = sprite-prio byte = ((byte2>>2)&0x10)|0x20  (BOTH tails; sourced from byte2 $1D5C)
$1D30 = 0x10 or 0xF0 only in one-way shape 0x1E (force Y velocity +/-16; conveyor push)
uncertainties: X-axis SCALE: I conclude $1D66 low byte spans the FULL sub-tile in 256 units (one 16px tile = 0x100 position units, i.e. 16 subpixels/pixel), because only then do the table offsets (0x3D=61,0x7D=125) and shifts(1..3) produce clean diagonals; with a 0..15 pixel X they degenerate to all-solid/all-walk. This matches AND $1D1E being a cell-mask on the 16-bit position. NOT yet confirmed against a live trace (boot_trace_play.txt never reaches 9ADB during its 34 controller frames -- the captured walk took an early-out, velocity likely 0). Recommend the verifier confirm $1D62/$1D66 fixed-point scale (256/tile) from the 9C5C path or a fresh trace that actually moves into a slope tile.

Y proxy is $1D68>>2 (0..63), while X is shifted by 1..3 -> X range 0..127/0..63/0..31. The asymmetric quantization (Y always /4, X variable) is faithful to the asm but means slope STEEPNESS is encoded by the X shift count; verify my steep/shallow labels against the editor's named collision types if available.

Special-shape switch (9B86): the disasm shows BEQ 9BA2 as the FIRST test, relying on the Z flag from the DEC chain at 9AEB/9AEE rather than an explicit CMP. I modeled it as a clean switch on (shape-2). The equal-to-0x16 path (orig 0x18) reaches 9BA2; the CMP/BCC ladder for 0x17..0x1C is explicit. The fallthrough 9BA0 BRA 9B41 covers any value >0x1C up to the 9AF1 CMP #$16 boundary -- but note the boundary means special path only runs for shape-2 in [0x16,0xFF]; shape-2>0x1C falls to walk. Confirm no real tile uses orig shape 0x1F+ (would be walk-by-default).

One-way velocity-sign tests use $1D66/$1D68 as SIGNED 8-bit (BMI/BPL on the low byte). Since these are the low bytes of 16-bit values, the sign read is the low-byte bit7, i.e. it tests bit7 of the position-low, NOT the true 16-bit velocity sign. This is faithful to the asm (LDA $66; BPL/BMI on 8-bit A) but is semantically the foot-pixel position parity/sign, not velocity. FLAG: re-derive whether in the 9C5C path $66/$68 at this point actually hold the velocity (they hold position low here). The MEMORY note calls $1D66/$1D68 'tentative next position', so these one-way tests gate on POSITION low byte sign, consistent with directional/one-way tiles keyed by which half of the tile you are entering from. Verify against an actual one-way tile.

Mapping to Python solid_at(t,sx,sy) (engine.py): the Python set only models t in {0,1,2,3,4,5,22..30} as triangles/halves/quadrants/ladder and treats ALL OTHER slope ids (6..21) as fully solid (return True). The real game's shapes 0x06-0x15 are genuine 22.5deg shallow/steep diagonals (not solid), and shapes 0x18-0x1E are velocity-gated one-way tiles (Python has NO equivalent). Also Python's collision id = (b0>>2)&0x1F (0..31) matches shape=(byte0&0xFC)>>2 EXACTLY (same field). MISMATCHES to fix in the C port / oracle: (a) Python's 45deg triangle orientation mapping (its t=2..5 = Corner45 NW/NE/SW/SE) must be re-checked against my shape 0x02..0x05 rendered geometry; my renders give 0x02=solid lower-right, 0x03=solid lower-left, 0x04=solid upper-left, 0x05=solid upper-right -- Python's solid_at(2)=sx+sy<16 (upper-left solid) does NOT match shape 0x02 (lower-right). The id->geometry correspondence between Python's t and CT's shape is therefore OFF by orientation/index; the C port must use the ROM-table evaluator, not solid_at. (b) Python collapses sub-pixel X to sx in 0..15 then compares to 8; CT uses the 256-unit position with table shift -- different thresholds at tile edges. (c) Python has no one-way (0x18-0x1E) and no conveyor force-set of velocity.

Slope solidity polarity: I take BPL(result bit7 clear)->WALKABLE, BMI->SOLID, because the BPL target is 9B41 (the walkable tail that sets z-plane=byte2&3, the 'free' tile config) and the z-gate at 9C3B treats $6A (z-plane) further. This is consistent but the 'walk vs solid' naming of the two tails is inferred from their downstream use (solid tail uses (byte2&0x18)>>3 for a DIFFERENT z field). Verify the tail naming with the apply step 9C5C: after this returns, 9C37 z-gate sets carry, and 9C96 BCC continues / else STZ $2E/$30 (blocked). So carry-set==blocked, and the tail merely populates $6A/$6C which 9C37 reads -- the 'solid tail' is reached when the foot point is in the solid half. Cross-check that 9C37 with the solid-tail's $6A/$6C actually yields carry-set in the blocking cases.

The DEC/Z-flag entry to the 9B86 switch: when orig shape==2, 9AEB DEC->1 (nz), 9AEE DEC->0... no: shape starts as (byte0&0xFC)>>2; 9AE9 BEQ catches 0; 9AEB DEC;BEQ catches 1; 9AEE DEC gives shape-2 with Z set iff shape was 2. Then STA $60; CMP #$16. For the BRL 9B86 path Z reflects (shape-2)-? Actually CMP #$16 sets flags; at 9B86 the first op is BEQ 9BA2 which uses the Z from CMP #$16 (BCS taken means shape-2>=0x16; BEQ fires iff shape-2==0x16). So my switch is correct: 0x16->9BA2. Confirmed, low uncertainty -- noting for completeness.
